question: What previously arranged worship located in the liṅga must be addressed?
premises: Worship was previously arranged in the middle of the liṅga.
That worship was established at an earlier time.
It is the object of the subsequent ritual action.
inference: Therefore the worship previously arranged in the middle of the liṅga must be ritually dismissed.
plain_english: The worship previously arranged in the middle of the liṅga at an earlier time must be addressed.
